employer_drafts.label: Draft A - over-restricted data internship
employer_drafts.text:
Data Analyst Intern - Copper Canyon Retail (Tempe, AZ)
We are looking for a rockstar data ninja to join our fast-paced team. You will build Tableau dashboards and write SQL to analyze store sales, and present insights to leadership. Requirements: must be a U.S. citizen; 3+ years of professional experience with SQL and Tableau; digital native who grew up with social media; recent graduates only (Class of 2025). This role is onsite 5 days a week in Tempe and is unpaid, full-time (40 hours/week) for the summer.

employer_drafts.text:
Data Analyst Intern - Copper Canyon Retail (Remote or hybrid in Tempe, AZ)
Join our analytics team for a paid summer internship ($25/hour, 12 weeks). You will write SQL to analyze store sales, build Tableau dashboards for store managers, and present one recommendation to leadership. Class projects count as experience. Preferred skills: SQL, Excel, Tableau or any visualization tool. International students are welcome; we support CPT and OPT work authorization.
